subject: BENCHMITTENS
name: Mittens (orange tabby beside a curly-haired man)

styleSelection.reason: Watercolour portrait sketch: fine sepia lines carry the likeness (ears, eyes, whiskers, face contour); a few light, soft-edged washes carry the cat's orange patches and the face planes; white paper carries the muzzle, chest, forehead and cheeks. Detail stays dry and crisp, patch edges turn soft into paper.

MIT.human-hair.reason: Curls are below four cells as separate locks: one connected blue-grey value wash with paper flecks, one darker glaze under the curls, a few curl gestures in pen.

MIT.human-hair-side.reason: Same curly mass running down behind the ear: grey wash, one shadow glaze, broken edge into paper.

families.referenceCue: Orange tabby head looking up: white ground with clean burnt-sienna and raw-sienna patches on the brow, between the eyes and on the cheek, their edges soft and lost into paper; white muzzle; pale green-grey eyes with dark rims and slit pupils, kept dry and crisp; fine whiskers drawn in pen.

Cat chest mostly white paper; raw and burnt sienna streaks down the left edge and a mid sienna fur strip behind the man's cheek with paper flecks, laid as a few soft-edged strokes, never a solid dark band.
Dark curly hair: blue-grey wash with broken edges into paper, darkest under the curls and along the hairline, white flecks between curls.
Hair falling behind the right ear, grey with a broken edge into white paper.

Face mostly paper: forehead, nose bridge and cheeks white or a whisper of warm tint; a light sepia-grey shadow down the left cheek against the cat and along the right jaw, softened where the cheek turns; brows and lids dark brown and crisp; stubble a broken pale grey-brown round the smile.

reserves.reason: catchlight, cat's near (right) eye, upper left of the slit pupil
catchlight, cat's far (left) eye, beside the pupil
catchlight, man's left eye, upper right of the iris
catchlight, man's right eye, upper right of the iris
